history.body: Hi, saw the Pearl Residences ad. We’re renting a small place now and looking for our first home. The 3 bedrooms caught my eye—would that suit a couple with a young child?

On paper, yes. Pearl Residences’ 900 sq.ft. layout has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, so you’d have a room for your child and a third room that could stay flexible for a study or guests. Since this is your first home, I’d recommend seeing the layout in person to judge whether the room sizes work for your family.
That sounds like it could work for us. Is there a show unit we can walk through?
Seeing the layout in person should help you judge whether the rooms feel right for your family. I’ll check whether there’s a show unit available to walk through and confirm the arrangements.
Okay, if there’s a show unit, I’d be interested in arranging a time to see it.

That makes sense. The show-unit availability is still being confirmed; if it’s available, seeing the 900 sq.ft. layout should help you judge whether the rooms feel right for your family. Once confirmed, we can arrange a suitable time.
